rules: Never treat a related quick screenshot as proof of multi-item bulk import
Original provider photos and user source ownership are unchanged
Only acknowledge bytes verified in durable private storage and membership records
Canceled or failed work cannot mark pending photos saved; explicit partial retention must remain possible
No Android Photo Picker UI is authored as a Glimpse-owned screen
No real Google Photos provider screenshot or native application is asserted from vector art

Bulk 22-photo import in progress, 17/22 verified, Continue disabled and cancellation described
Distinguish reconciled 22 selected from 20 saved/1 duplicate/1 skipped, enable Browse only for saved photos
Explicit Stop and retain verified copies vs continue, no claim unverified copies survive
No unverified cloud source presented as offline; Retry when available / keep verified copies
Out-of-space with 17/22 verified, accessible Keep verified and Free space / retry actions
